note: How the raw results in this folder were produced. Every number in summary.json comes from the files next to it (node scripts/envelope-spike.ts score).

preregistration.briefs: 78d3b57 Pre-register the envelope briefs (12 natural briefs, before any run of them)
preregistration.fit_options_patch: c344a1f Pass fitOptions through compute run jobs for the envelope spike
preregistration.corpus: 52e2f3c Pre-register the seeded envelope corpus (15 defects, 10 controls, regions, scoring rule, seeds; after the corpus lint, before any search or random sampling)
preregistration.harness: f323f9d Add the envelope spike search, certificates and replay
preregistration.change_after_preregistration: Before the measurement runs, a smoke run on flange, d01, d05 and c07 at budget 24 and 64 showed the compass search would follow an equality assertion with margin 0 everywhere; the compass now follows only assertions whose margin varies, and unused budget goes to further Halton points (in f323f9d). In the measurement runs the compass search never ran on a seeded defect, because every defect had a counterexample before the compass phase.

commands.step: guided search, all 25 corpus briefs and 12 natural briefs
uniform random baseline, 25 corpus briefs, seeds 1 to 10
replay of every certificate point in a new process, each on a fresh kernel (freshKernel: true)
M5, enclosure alone, one process per configuration, run one after the other

lane_note: The measurement runs used the interactive lane so all 4 workers ran jobs; the lane changes scheduling only. The M5 certificates from 1 worker (batch), 4 workers (batch, 3 usable) and 4 workers (interactive) have the same certificate hash as certs/enclosure.cert.json.
m6: not run (optional): no mutants were generated or scored.
